Haploinsufficiency of GLI3 disrupts the Sonic Hedgehog signaling pathway, which is crucial for limb and craniofacial development. This disruption leads to abnormal limb development, specifically postaxial polydactyly, and other digit abnormalities in polydactyly, postaxial, type A1.
